description:
The settings of one layer file, holding only the fields that file sets

`settings.json` is the global layer's file and `projects/<id>/settings.json`
one project's. These types are what the schema is written from, so a file
kelpie reads can hold nothing they do not describe.

$schema.description: The schema this file is written against

bridge-updates.description: Where each bridge's new versions come from, keyed by the bridge's registry id such as `claude-acp`. A bridge the map does not name takes `registry-automatic`.

catch-up.description: When a pull request behind the base is caught up with it: always, or only on a conflict. A branch that merges cleanly then goes on unrebased, and the merge queue or the base's CI tests the combination.

ci-holds-merge.description: Whether CI holds a merge. Off, kelpie reads no checks and asks for the merge once the branch has the latest base.

ci-wait.description: How many minutes a check may sit queued before a rerun, and how long a head with no check waits before a ruling

done-window.description: How many days a closed ticket stays in the board's Done column. A closed ticket older than this is off the board.

fix-attempts.description: How many fix turns the worker gets on red runs for one ticket before kelpie rules instead. 0 rules on the first red run, and a project that sets none has no cap.

harness-global-folder.description: Whether a harness may read the global config folder it keeps for itself: Claude Code's `~/.claude`, or `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` when the person set it, and goose's `~/.config/goose`, or the `config` folder under `GOOSE_PATH_ROOT` when the person set it. Each applies when the session next starts.

host.description: The host a provider runs on

lease-capacity.description: How many commands hold each lease at once, keyed by the lease's name such as `cargo-test`. A lease the map does not name takes kelpie's own capacity for it, and no lease holds zero.

network-allowlist.description: Domains a sandbox request may reach, one saved with *Allow for this project*

pick-up.description: Whose of a project's issues kelpie picks up as tickets. An issue carrying the ready label is a ticket either way.

pm-effort.description: How much effort the PM puts in, named as the harness names it. Empty leaves the effort to the harness.

pm-harness.description: Which harness the PM's next message runs on. Where it is empty, the `pm` agent's own harness decides.

pm-model.description: Which model the PM runs on, named as the harness names it. Empty leaves the model to the harness.

provider.description: Where a harness's model runs, for a harness that reaches a model through a server

read-anywhere.description: Whether an agent reads anywhere, instead of only the project it works in and the folders beside it. Every harness's login, every secret and every other session's state folder stay denied. The change lands when the session next starts, on a relaunch or a harness switch.

ready-label.description: The label a ticket carries to be Ready, named as the ticket source names it. It names one label, so it holds no comma.

reply-style.description: How kelpie asks a harness to phrase its replies

reviewer-effort.description: How much effort every listed reviewer puts in, named as the harness names it. Empty leaves the effort to each reviewer agent and the harness.

reviewer-harness.description: Which harness every listed reviewer runs on. Where it is empty, each reviewer agent's own harness decides.

reviewer-model.description: Which model every listed reviewer runs on, named as the harness names it. Empty leaves the model to each reviewer agent and the harness.

reviewers.description: The reviewer agents this project uses, by name, in the order they read. An empty list means no reviewer can run, and a name listed twice is refused.

run-without-sandbox.description: Whether the project's PM runs without a sandbox. It applies only while the machine's sandbox cannot start, and only to the PM: a worker never runs without one.

test-command.description: A command that runs one failing test a reviewer wrote, with the test file's path at `{test}` or its file stem at `{name}`, such as `cargo test --test {name}`. Set, a reviewer is asked to leave a failing test for each finding it can. Absent, none is asked.

theme.description: How kelpie's window looks. `system` follows the OS's appearance; `light` and `dark` say otherwise. The window's own theme is set to match, at once and with no restart.

worker-effort.description: How much effort a worker puts in, named as the harness names it. Empty leaves the effort to the harness.

worker-harness.description: Which harness a worker runs on. Where it is empty, the `worker` agent's own harness decides.

worker-model.description: Which model a worker runs on, named as the harness names it. Empty leaves the model to the harness.

worker-slots.description: How many of this project's workers run at once. A worker that is Paused or waiting on the maintainer holds no slot. 0 holds every worker out of the project's slots.

worker-turn-timeout.description: How many minutes a worker's turn may run before kelpie cancels it and pauses the worker. The count starts when the worker's slot is granted, not when its process launches.
